newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco urges Turkey to withdraw troops from Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Morocco urges Turkey to withdraw troops from Iraq.

text.p: Morocco on Tuesday urged Turkey to withdraw its troops from northern Iraq and put and end to its military actions in its neighbouring country, the official MAP news agency reported.
"Morocco follows with anxiety the situation in Iraq after the incursion of Turkey's armed forces in (northern) territory of Iraq," MAP quoted the foreign ministry as saying.

Morocco, which insists on preserving the independence and sovereign territorial integrity of Iraq "demands that Turkey's forces withdraw from Iraq and put an end to the pursuit of such military actions," the ministry added.
The Arab League secretariat on Monday condemned Turkey's military operation in northern Iraq and demanded Turkish forces withdraw immediately.
NATO-member Turkey's Western allies and Middle Eastern countries have criticised the incursion.
